context: Request: general litigation matters that had a fee-shifting provision, with documents, for a fee-shifting playbook. Rubric: 14 qualifying matters (1006-00005, 1008-00007, 1010-00005, 1012-00006, 1019-00005, 1020-00005, 1021-00006, 1023-00002, 1024-00003, 1027-00003, 1033-00006, 1035-00004, 1038-00007, 1044-00006), each with a proof document, plus a precision criterion; several have same-client sibling matters.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a two-level folder listing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). A heredoc error, then an inventory of file counts per matter saved to a file. The end label note names the folder-listing stage, and the next stage is declared as such.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: List matter folders. Greps the saved inventory for pleadings, litigation, discovery, motions, court and settlement folder words; all fourteen later-needed matters appear. The end label note names the document-type search; no further such search follows.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide fee-term scan times out and is rerun in four ranges; a per-matter summary of broad fee terms (about 181K characters, 252 matters), a timed-out phrase scan read with head and sed caps, then a scan for the single exact phrase 'fee-shifting'. The review flags the timeouts, the caps and the noisy broad pool and asks for a chunked rerun of the phrase scan.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: the exact-phrase scan rerun over all 266 matters; 41 matters with hits are carried forward. The review flags that a single exact phrase likely omits qualifying matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads one document each from about 19 pool matters (memos, briefs, complaints, a settlement draft), choosing siblings of two pool matters, then a clause-snippet script over selected files (about 92K characters). The review flags about 60 surfaced matters never opened.

runs.failure_point: It narrowed its candidate pool to documents using the literal phrase 'fee-shifting', then picked same-client siblings over two pool matters.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [52] said the single exact phrase likely omits provisions worded as prevailing-party or attorneys'-fees clauses; the agent screened only the 41 hits. The review at [44] had asked for a chunked rerun of that same phrase scan.
first_error.why: The broad fee-term summary at [33]-[34] reached every needed matter, but the agent then built its pool from a scan for the one exact phrase 'fee-shifting' (rerun at [47]-[50]), which dropped four needed matters that never reached the answer.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [78] said about 60 surfaced matters were never opened, without naming these; the agent then covered only its own confirmed list.
other_errors.why: Two needed matters were in the 41-matter pool at [50], but the agent read same-client sibling matters instead and never opened them.
The answer lists a matter whose mediation brief it read at [64] among matters without a fee-shifting provision.

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews pushed for more coverage and source checks; the write review gave only stock warnings.
other_errors.why: The answer asserts sibling matters and other matters outside the qualifying set as fee-shifting examples (evidence seen at [55]-[124]).

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [56] said the candidate set rested on capped snippets and asked to open each matter's operative document; the follow-up stage covered three matters.
first_error.why: For one needed matter its snippet pattern caught only pre-suit letters, not the complaint or motion papers, and the agent never listed that matter's folder, so its answer cites pre-suit documents as proof.

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review at [72] asked to confirm every matter that surfaced in earlier scans was included or excluded with a reason; the agent checked only paths.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts many matters outside the qualifying set, including transactional and sibling matters, as fee-shifting litigation examples (evidence seen at [36]-[64]).

divergence: All three runs fail. T2 ended on context overflow from a store-wide scan that printed every hit. T0 and T1 both listed matter folders, ran store-wide fee-term scans that timed out and were rerun in ranges, screened candidates and wrote long lists. T0 narrowed its pool to the literal phrase 'fee-shifting' (flagged specifically, after an earlier review had asked for a rerun of that phrase scan), lost four needed matters and picked same-client siblings for two more, passing 15 of 29. T1 kept a tight clause-pattern pool over a litigation inventory that reached every needed matter, passed 23 of 29, but dropped two matters whose clauses appeared only in a capped snippet dump. Both also listed many extra matters. Label notes were followed once (T0 declared a folder-listing stage after the end note) and otherwise ignored.
